title: PipePipe: NewPipe hard fork implementing SponsorBlock
why_read: A concrete open-source fork adding ad-skipping crowdsourced data to a YouTube frontend, relevant to engineers interested in mobile app forking and API reverse engineering.
analysis: PipePipe is a fork of NewPipe, itself a YouTube client that avoids Google's official API, and this fork adds SponsorBlock integration to automatically skip sponsored segments. It is technically interesting for how it maintains extraction logic against a platform that actively works to block third-party clients. The project sits in a legal and ethical gray zone regarding YouTube's terms of service, which is worth noting but does not make it inherently harmful.
